title: PhoPunct: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Transformer Architectures for Vietnamese Punctuation Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.09107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vietnamese punctuation restoration is often evaluated on relatively small benchmarks, limiting conclusions about how architectural choices scale with data volume. We present a controlled benchmark on News and Novels corpora containing 22.1 million labeled tokens (19.9M News and 2.2M Novels). We evaluate 17 architectures formed from four pretrained Transformer backbones and optional bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and conditional random field (CRF) layers, together with a PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF model, PhoPunct. Every model is trained for eight epochs with the same learning rate and without architecture-specific tuning. Under this fixed budget, adding Bi-LSTM and CRF layers does not reliably improve macro F1: in seven of eight matched domain-backbone comparisons, a plain Transformer classifier matches or outperforms its Bi-LSTM-CRF counterpart. translated_title: PhoPunct：用于越南语标点恢复的大规模Transformer架构基准测试
translated_abstract: 越南语标点恢复任务通常在相对较小的基准上进行评估，这限制了关于架构选择如何随数据量扩展的结论。我们在包含2210万个标注词元（1990万新闻和220万小说）的新闻和小说语料库上提出了一个受控基准。我们评估了由四个预训练Transformer主干网络与可选的双向长短期记忆网络和条件随机场层组合而成的17种架构，以及一个名为PhoPunct的PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF模型。所有模型均在相同学习率下训练八个周期，且不进行针对特定架构的调优。在这一固定预算下，添加Bi-LSTM和CRF层并不能可靠地提升宏观F1分数：在八组匹配的领域-主干对比中，有七组显示纯Transformer分类器与其对应的Bi-LSTM-CRF模型相当或更优。PhoPunct获得了新闻语料上的最佳结果（61.35），而带有CRF的XLM-R则获得……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了包含2210万标注词元的越南语标点恢复大规模基准，评估17种Transformer架构后发现，在固定训练预算下添加Bi-LSTM和CRF层并不能可靠提升性能，纯Transformer分类器在大多数对比中与Bi-LSTM-CRF模型相当甚至更优。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale Vietnamese punctuation restoration benchmark with 22.1 million labeled tokens, evaluating 17 Transformer architectures and showing that under a fixed training budget, adding Bi-LSTM and CRF layers does not reliably improve macro F1, with plain Transformer classifiers matching or outperforming their Bi-LSTM-CRF counterparts in most comparisons.
